summary: A calculator loses the most users on the page that asks them to copy figures from a paycheck.
realLife: IRS tracking showed the pay-stub entry page was the most common exit point in its 2018 withholding calculator. For multiple-job households, IRS later described a paper worksheet in its redesigned W-4 instructions for workers who could not use the online estimator.
inGame: needs: page-level figures identify a particular step as the most common exit.
